rv.q: My Fair Lady is the epitome of a timeless musical treasure; the example you would give to someone who asked, "What makes a great musical?"
The entire production is flawless from beginning to end. At almost three hours, it absolutely flies by.
Without a wretched LCD screen in sight, the lavish and painstaking recreation is a true work of beauty, all the better when blessed with such a stellar cast.
But regardless of its sexist undertones, My Fair Lady is musical theatre gold, and decades later, its lustre still shines brightly.
From its magnificent performances to its dazzling costumes and extraordinary staging, every element feels considered and beautifully executed.
In the Ian Potter State Theatre, My Fair Lady has found a grand new home and stands as one of Melbourne's genuine theatre highlights of 2026.

cn.t: Critics rave about Melbourne's My Fair Lady revival, praising its dazzling production design and enduring charm. A near-unanimous hit, this 70th anniversary staging earns top marks across the board.

ta: Ian Potter State Theatre, 100 St Kilda Road, Melbourne VIC 3004
